Record Class DecisionFigureTornado.Bar

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
network.ike.docs.koncept.DecisionFigureTornado.Bar
Record Components:
name - how the measure is named
low - the measure's lower end
high - the measure's upper end
stated - whether the block stated the range, which draws the bar solid
rootAtLow - the root's cost at the lower end
rootAtHigh - the root's cost at the upper end
leastRoot - the least root cost anywhere in the range
greatestRoot - the greatest root cost anywhere in the range
segments - the stretches between the root's flips, in rising order of the measure
ticks - every flip, at any decision
Enclosing class:
DecisionFigureTornado
public static record DecisionFigureTornado.Bar(String name, double low, double high, boolean stated, double rootAtLow, double rootAtHigh, double leastRoot, double greatestRoot, List<DecisionFigureTornado.Segment> segments, List<DecisionFigureTornado.Tick> ticks) extends Record
One measure's bar.

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:

      Parameters:
